comparator.name: Political Science: Global Politics
comparator.sourceNotes: The September 2026 English-language Global Politics route uses Appendix III page 28 for years 1 and 2 and Article 12 for 30 EC of open study. The two year-two Social Science for Society slots are separate restricted choices. English diagnostic and any required remediation must pass before the first Academic Skills workshop grade is determined. Years 1 and 2 list zero-credit mentorship. Article 9.1 sets the general thesis entry minimum at 90 programme EC excluding electives and including the Academic Skills workshops. Page 29 explicitly labels the final 30 EC and third-year mentorship for entrants through 2024–2025. The current programme page names the three final units without an entrant-specific credit table.

routeSelection.basis: Registry resolution case rc-0074 (normalization status step2-resolved-split) explicitly identifies cp-000112 as the English-taught 'Global Politics' track/version of the shared VU Political Science registration, distinct from the Dutch 'Politicologie: Nationale Politiek en Bestuur' track (cp-000113); the registry's own targets metadata records {"language":"ENG","focus":"global politics"} for this exact target. OER Article 10.2 confirms that, starting cohort 2025-2026, the bachelor's programme (RIO 56606) offers exactly two named tracks -- 'Politicologie: Nationale Politiek en Bestuur' (Dutch) and 'Political Science: Global Politics' (English) -- so the normalized target itself names this exact official route (Section 2.1 rule 1), confirmed by current official evidence for the 2026-2027 academic year and by the English-language 'political-science-global-politics' curriculum, future and admissions webpages themselves.

programmes.label: Political Science: Global Politics at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

exception.reason: The first two years and 30 EC of open study are verified for the revised route. VU names three final-year units, but the adopted regulations give the remaining credit allocation only for earlier entrants. The revised cohort’s final 30 EC, including its thesis allocation and any third-year mentorship requirement, still need confirmation.
exception.curriculumContext: The verified 150 EC covers political institutions and theory, international relations, governance, security, political economy, quantitative and qualitative research, and open study.

audience.programmeDescription: VU Global Politics studies political power and changing relationships between states and other actors. Students examine comparative politics, international relations, governance, the EU, political economy, security and political theory, and develop quantitative, qualitative, writing and debating skills.
audience.comparisonExplanation: VU’s published materials confirm 150 of 180 EC for the revised route. The final-year credit allocation for September 2026 entrants still needs confirmation, so the table shows the verified curriculum only.

curriculum.limitation: The verified 150 EC includes the first two years and a 30 EC open semester in year three. The remaining 30 EC includes the final project, but VU’s published credit table applies to earlier entrants.
